paragraphs.text: Oriel Kjeldos (or-ee-EL KYEL-dohss ) was a shaman , the leader of Clan Emerald of Storgard , in the Ice Age of Dominaria .

Oriel was the leader of Clan Emerald of Storgard by 2434 AR . She took in a young Jason Carthalion as her ward after the death of his parents. Before the Fall of Storgard , she led a large band of others, including Jason, Hurn , Mariska , and 48 other members of Clan Pearl and Clan Emerald, away from the doomed citadel. Legend has it that Oriel tamed the first Aesthir . Though she eventually died on the journey from Storgard, Oriel is considered one of Kjeldor 's founders.

Clan Onyx leader Arimaya referred to Oriel as her "Emerald sister", although this may have been poetic language rather than referring to a blood relation. Kjeldos's descendants settled in the lands that would become the kingdom of Kjeldor, and this family became the new kingdom's first dynasty, using "Kjeld" as a family name. An explorer descendant of hers founded the city of the same name, which would become the nation's first capital. The nation's founder was honored each winter in a celebration called the Feast of Kjeld. Around 2930, the city's prince was Darien Kjeld , and Onala Kjeld served as a knight.
